article.title: How to turn your AI into a world-class designer
article.author: Anshu Chimala
article.accessBoundary: The public page exposed the introduction, Discover and Define material, techniques 1 through 6, and the heading for technique 7. Technique 7 body content was behind the paid-subscriber boundary and was not read or inferred.
guidanceApplied: Pursue a specific, ambitious design identity instead of default dashboard patterns.
Judge the visible composition independently of implementation rationale.
Use the supplied image only where it adds pertinent identity.
Remove low-value chrome and keep attention on the immediate task.

additionalContextFilesRead.scope: Relevant Development System workflow-boundary registry lines only; no design direction was taken from memory.

thesis: Clinical context should feel like a prepared folio rather than a crowded dashboard: one dominant decision surface, one supporting time rail, and a brief context layer that leaves the current task visually intact.

composition: An asymmetric two-part stage pairs a large clinical folio with an editorial next-visit rail in Expediente.
Portal keeps the same visual grammar but shifts emphasis to one dark daily-plan surface and a narrow stack for habits, appointment and the available care-team message.
The synthetic portrait is cropped discreetly into a compact identity chip and remains subordinate to task content.
hierarchy: Expediente leads with diabetes type 2, then allergy, medication, HbA1c and weight trend, with the next visit isolated as the supporting cue.
Portal leads with breakfast completed and lunch next, then shows only one progress signal, the next appointment and message availability.
Large heading contrast, limited labels and ledger-like rules replace repeated generic metric cards.
interaction: Expediente and Portal are keyboard-operable tabs with ArrowLeft and ArrowRight navigation.
Abrir contexto opens a fixed modal panel over either view without reflowing the background.
The panel traps Tab focus, closes from its controls, scrim or Escape, and restores focus to the exact trigger.
The background is made inert while open, scroll is held, and reduced-motion preferences collapse animations and transitions.

expressiveOpportunity: The oversized visit date, offset folio edge and confident ink-blue fields create a memorable editorial clinical identity without adding new colors, decorative media or extra dashboard modules.
concreteRisk: The low-density, large-type composition may move secondary clinical signals below the first viewport on compact screens; a real product pass would need task-timing evidence before preserving this exact scale.
